storage_dir.description: Base directory where rdiff signature, delta, and patch files are stored.

remote_user.description: Remote user account for SSH-based rdiff operations.

ssh_port.description: SSH port number for remote connections.

compression_level.description: Compression level for generated signature and delta files (0-9).

max_age_days.description: Retention period in days for old backup data before cleanup.

source_dirs.description: List of directories to back up using rdiff signature/delta/patch cycle.

source_dirs.items.description: Individual directory entry for rdiff backup.

source_dirs.items.src.description: Source directory path to compute signature from.

source_dirs.items.dest.description: Destination path relative to storage_dir where backup state is kept.

extra_options.description: List of additional command-line options for rdiff commands.
